Stephanie, a native of Orange County, California, has been an integral part of the insurance industry since obtaining her Property & Casualty license in 2008. Her dedication to serving clients and her love for family adventures make her an invaluable asset in providing personalized insurance solutions.

When she's not assisting clients with their insurance needs, Stephanie cherishes moments with her family, both indoors and amidst nature. During weekends, they, along with their four dogs, enjoy fishing and camping in Northern California, while also exploring Newport Beach's Back Bay. Stephanie's passion for baking and decorating cakes adds a delightful touch to family gatherings, enjoyed immensely by her husband and son.
